course_description: This course covers fundamental concepts of calculus, including differentiation and integration, and their applications. It also introduces ordinary differential equations (ODE) and methods for solving them.
An introduction to chemical principles, including atomic structure, bonding, and reactions. Lab sessions focus on experiments to reinforce theoretical knowledge.
Basics of electrical circuits, components, and analysis techniques. The lab provides hands-on experience with circuit design and testing.
Study of electronic devices, such as diodes and transistors, and their applications in circuits. Lab work includes constructing and analyzing electronic circuits.
Introduction to technical drawing and drafting techniques used in engineering. Emphasizes creating and interpreting engineering diagrams and blueprints.
Fundamental principles of mechanics, including statics and dynamics, and their applications in engineering. Topics include force systems, equilibrium, and kinematics.
Practical course focused on media production, covering aspects like video editing, sound design, and content creation. Students work on projects to develop technical and creative skills.
Course designed to improve proficiency in English, with a focus on grammar, composition, and communication skills. Enhances both written and spoken English abilities.
Explores the basics of starting and running a business, including idea generation, business planning, and market analysis. Encourages innovation and entrepreneurial thinking.
Introductory course to French language, covering basic grammar, vocabulary, and conversational skills. Aims to develop foundational language proficiency.
Studies matrix theory, vector spaces, linear transformations, and functions of a complex variable, including differentiation and integration of complex functions.
Covers fundamental principles of mechanics, waves, and thermodynamics, with practical experiments to reinforce theoretical concepts.
Provides an overview of cellular structure, genetics, evolution, and ecological principles, focusing on the molecular and physiological processes of life.
Introduces basic programming concepts, data structures, algorithms, and computer organization, with hands-on lab sessions.
Practical training in basic engineering skills, including machining, welding, and assembly techniques.
Explores the structure and composition of the Earth, environmental systems, and the impact of human activities on natural processes.
Covers foundational topics in discrete mathematics, such as logic, set theory, combinatorics, graph theory, and algorithms.
Practical course focused on developing entrepreneurial skills, business planning, and the execution of business ideas.
Examines ethical theories and their application to professional conduct, focusing on integrity, responsibility, and ethical decision-making in various professions.
Basic course in French language, emphasizing conversational skills, vocabulary, and introductory grammar.

This course typically covers advanced calculus, differential equations, and linear algebra, focusing on their applications in engineering and science. It is designed to provide a strong mathematical foundation for problem-solving in various technical fields.

This subject deals with advanced topics in physics such as electromagnetism, quantum mechanics, and thermodynamics. It builds upon the fundamentals learned in introductory physics courses to explore more complex physical phenomena.

This course introduces the fundamental data structures used in computer science, such as arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs. It emphasizes the importance of data organization and manipulation for efficient algorithm design and problem-solving.

This subject focuses on mathematical optimization methods used in artificial intelligence, including linear programming, convex optimization, and heuristic algorithms. It aims to equip students with the tools to improve AI model performance and efficiency.

This course explores the analysis and processing of signals and the behavior of systems that produce and modify signals. Topics include Fourier transforms, Laplace transforms, and system response, with applications in communication and control systems.

This practical course offers hands-on experience in programming, focusing on coding skills, debugging, and software development. It typically includes projects and exercises to reinforce learning and application of programming concepts.

This subject teaches the principles of the lean start-up methodology, which emphasizes rapid prototyping, validated learning, and iterative product development. It aims to help aspiring entrepreneurs build successful startups with minimal resources.

This course covers fundamental economic principles, including microeconomics and macroeconomics. Topics include supply and demand, market structures, economic policies, and their impact on individuals and businesses.
This language course focuses on developing proficiency in French, covering speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills. It also includes an introduction to French culture and society.

This advanced mathematics course often covers topics such as complex analysis, numerical methods, and partial differential equations. It aims to deepen mathematical knowledge and enhance analytical skills for solving complex problems.

This subject explores the principles of digital circuits, logic design, and the architecture of computer systems. Key topics include Boolean algebra, sequential logic, memory systems, and processor design.

This course introduces fundamental concepts and techniques in artificial intelligence and computational intelligence, such as neural networks, genetic algorithms, and fuzzy logic. It focuses on building intelligent systems and solving complex computational problems.

This subject delves into the theoretical foundations of computer science, including automata theory, formal languages, and computational complexity. It aims to provide a rigorous understanding of what can be computed and the resources required.

This course covers the principles and algorithms of machine learning, including supervised and unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, and neural networks. It emphasizes practical applications and hands-on experience with real-world data.

This practical course offers hands-on experience in programming, focusing on coding skills, debugging, and software development. It typically includes projects and exercises to reinforce learning and application of programming concepts.

This subject teaches the iterative process of design thinking, which involves empathy, ideation, prototyping, and testing. It aims to foster creative problem-solving skills and innovative thinking for product and service development.

This course introduces the principles and practices of financial accounting, including recording, summarizing, and reporting financial transactions. It covers key concepts such as the accounting cycle, financial statements, and generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).
This language course focuses on developing proficiency in French, covering speaking, listening, reading, and writing skills. It also includes an introduction to French culture and society.

This course focuses on the design, analysis, and implementation of algorithms, covering concepts such as time complexity, space complexity, and algorithmic paradigms like divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, and greedy algorithms. It aims to equip students with techniques for solving computational problems efficiently.

This subject introduces the principles of object-oriented programming (OOP) using languages such as Java or C++. Key topics include classes, objects, inheritance, polymorphism, and encapsulation, with an emphasis on designing reusable and modular software.

This course covers the fundamental concepts and functions of operating systems, including process management, memory management, file systems, and concurrency. It aims to provide an understanding of how operating systems manage hardware resources and support application software.

This subject explores the principles of database design, implementation, and management, focusing on relational database systems. Topics include SQL, normalization, transaction management, and database security, with practical experience in database development and querying.

This course delves into the architecture, programming, and interfacing of microprocessors and microcontrollers. It includes topics such as assembly language programming, input/output interfacing, and the integration of microprocessors with peripheral devices.

This course covers the principles and technologies involved in managing and analyzing large datasets. Topics include Hadoop, Spark, data mining, and visualization, focusing on extracting meaningful insights from vast amounts of data.

This subject explores the fundamentals of computer networking, including network architectures, protocols, and technologies. Key topics include the OSI model, TCP/IP, routing, switching, and network security.

This course focuses on the design and implementation of computing systems that can handle intensive computational tasks. Topics include parallel computing, distributed systems, and optimization techniques for achieving high performance.

This subject introduces the methodologies and practices of software development, including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance. It emphasizes the importance of software project management and quality assurance.
